metrics.method: Full history 2025-08-25 → 2026-09-22 (1,873 non-service messages: 1,111 client, 762 ours; client = 'LA Client' per config/clients.yaml, everyone else = our side incl. the Lauryn vendor chat team per config/team.yaml). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?' (95; these collapse to 71 distinct question threads under 30-minute grouping). unanswered_over_24h = 1 by the strict rule (no outbound message of any kind within 24h: only 2026-07-19 'can you send me split on invoice?', 43.1h) plus 1 answered-on-topic failure (the 2026-09-02/03 Facebook chase, first addressed 12 days later and to a colleague, not to her) = 2. Median first-reply lag 2 minutes, mean 1.6h, p90 3.2h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive outbound messages excluding automated DMCA/leak broadcasts (9.6d, 2025-12-05 → 2025-12-15); counting every outbound message the max is 8.1d (2025-12-23 → 2025-12-31); trailing silence at the run date is 2.9d. Promises = explicit, checkable, dated commitments made by our side (recurring cadences counted once each); kept = delivered at least through the period reviewed, lapsed = stopped or never delivered with no closing message.

'Gotta have page be able to have endless traction' (2025-09-27); 'It really messes with algorithms and traffic at this point, I'm seeing which delays the growth of page' (2025-10-08); 'It's very important for my page to be back up and functioning due to Business reasons 🙏🏽' (2026-08-18).

Visible momentum she can see in numbers — she tracks her own revenue closely and wants us in that conversation. 'Let's make this impactful 🚀🚀🚀' (2025-08-25); 'Let's really push Today Team these last few days left of month.. last month was def short our LOWEST money wise' (2026-03-28); 'My books are ran off what drops after pending state' (2026-07-30).

Her brand and her limits protected without having to re-argue them. 'My biggest thing is when they type and My Name with Naked" doesn't show any of that type of content for branding purposes' (2025-08-29); 'Just def want page protected at all costs' (2025-09-15); 'No exception for him / Just something I won't do' (2026-02-24).
To be told things rather than having to chase them. 'Keep me updated Mama 💜💜💜' (2025-09-27); 'Keep me updated pls / Well I'm periodically checking on my end as well' (2026-08-18).
what_worked: The DMCA/leak service is the only thing that ever built durable trust — 36 dated updates over 12 months with visible numbers going down. 'Insaneeee / But glad we cleaned it all up / Thank Youuuu 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽' (LA Client, 2025-08-28) and 'Wewww / Thank you for the update 🙏🏽' (2025-09-03). Keep this, and notice that we just broke it two weeks running.

Protecting the illusion for her fans, unprompted. Tanya: 'we'll pause chatting during your live events, we wanna make sure no fan would suspect you're using chatters' (2025-12-19) → 'Perfect!! / Thank youuu 💜💜' (2025-12-20). Same effect when we flagged an impersonator: 'Thank youuu / So fans won't be fooled' (2026-03-15).

Asking about her boundaries BEFORE taking a request, rather than negotiating after. King Choy: 'I just want to make sure we set the expectations before we take on some requests' (2025-08-30) → 'Thank Youuu / For communicating that with me 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽'. This is the exact behaviour the chat team abandoned from 2026-02 onward.

The one strategy document we ever produced landed. Sophie's 30-day report and 14-day game plan (2025-09-23) → 'I think we are on the right track / Moving Upward 📈 / Stradgey makes sense'. She engaged with it the same morning. We never sent a second one.
top_fix: Give this account one named internal owner who is accountable for a standing fortnightly report — revenue and subs, Facebook/platform status with a real owner and next step, and every open ask on both sides — sent whether or not there is good news, and escalated to Derrek if it slips. Every severe finding here is downstream of the same hole: when Sophie left on 2025-10-09 nobody inherited the job of telling Lauryn anything she had not personally chased. That single missing role is why 20 promises lapsed unnoticed, why a 363-day platform failure has bounced between four people with no owner, why she has had no performance number in 375 days, and why she was able to pay off six periods of balance and go quiet without a single person on our side registering it as a warning.
